overview_description.description: Plex is a globally available one-stop-shop streaming media service offering thousands of free movies and TV shows and hundreds of free-to-stream live TV channels from the biggest names in entertainment, including Warner Bros. Domestic Television Distribution, Lionsgate, Legendary, Sinclair Broadcast Group, AMC, A+E, Crackle, and BBC. Backed by Intercap and Kleiner Perkins, Plex is the only streaming service that lets users manage their media alongside a continuously growing library of free third-party entertainment spanning all genres, interests, and mediums including podcasts, music, and more. With a highly customizable interface and smart recommendations based on the media you enjoy, Plex brings its users the best media experience on the planet from any device, anywhere.

about_short_description.short_description: Plex offers streaming of movies, TV shows, and music, plus personal media organization across devices.

product.name: Plex Streaming Platform
product.description: A cross-device entertainment platform for streaming free ad-supported movies, TV shows, and live TV, with access to rentals and playback on supported devices.

product.name: Plex Media Server
product.description: Software that organizes a user’s personal movies, TV shows, music, photos, and videos into libraries and streams them to compatible devices from a computer or NAS.

product.name: Plex Pass
product.description: A paid subscription that adds premium features for Plex Media Server, including expanded personal-media playback capabilities, downloads, and access to selected exclusive applications.

product.name: Plex Discover
product.description: A content discovery and search service that combines catalog information from Plex, other streaming services, personal libraries, and rentals in one interface.

product.name: Plex Live TV & DVR
product.description: A live television and recording service that streams over-the-air broadcast channels and records programs when paired with Plex Media Server, a supported tuner, antenna, storage, and Plex Pass.

product.name: Plexamp
product.description: A music player designed for organized personal music libraries, providing playback and music-focused browsing through Plex Media Server on supported devices.
